resolutions.rationale: The passage is a complete, clearly attributed methodological argument, and no material wording uncertainty impedes assessment.
The long source span clearly preserves all four examples and the model-tethering conclusion, supporting confident assessment despite factual contestability.
The materialist constraint is intelligible, but the move improperly compresses evolution, Darwinism, and every atheistic origins account into one option.
Dembski supplies a conceptual constraint on purposeless origins, but gives no survey or evidence establishing Darwinism as the sole naturalistic account.
The move directly confronts Hitchens’s Darwin-based removal of God, although it emphasizes worldview dependence more than the biological merits.
Alleged worldview dependence is relevant motivational pressure, but it neither falsifies Darwinism nor positively establishes design as biologically superior.
The contrast is recoverable, yet repeated slippage among Darwinism, evolution, and purposeless natural origins materially blurs the categorical conclusion.
The straightjacket characterization imputes rigidity while overlooking alternative naturalistic mechanisms and uncertainty about a complete origins theory.
Pre-Darwin atheism defeats literal historical dependence, but does not answer the narrower claim that contemporary atheism requires some purposeless origins mechanism.
The named ancient atomists support historical priority, while the extended Newton material is indirect and adds little to logical independence.
Hitchens directly denies that atheists must be evolutionists, but mostly supplies historical examples rather than answering the self-organization constraint.
Breaking the claimed necessary linkage protects the con route from burden transfer, though it does not itself explain biological origins naturalistically.
The thesis and historical examples are understandable, but the terminology, alchemy, and church-hostility digressions blur the precise logical issue.
The historical denial is proportionate, but the pivot to organized religion’s hostility does not grant or engage Dembski’s narrower conceptual concern.
The eye-loss example demonstrates selection and degeneration, but it only weakly answers Dembski’s challenge about constructing integrated visual systems.
The speech meaning is corroborated, but the unusual zoological description and unverified observational details warrant medium rather than high confidence.
The evidence-versus-dogma contrast is vivid, but genetics, evolution, vaccine history, prediction, and all medicine are bundled with material overbreadth.
The genealogy-versus-objectivity distinction is coherent, but the move does not establish that naturalistic explanation defeats every secular objective moral theory.
The move is assessable, but its broad empirical correlations among religion, secularism, and contested practices remain asserted and underdocumented.
The analogy, crucifixion claim, and conversion testimony establish existential force, but not the asserted divine identity or salvific truth of Christ.
Supplemental transcription resolves the material wording and conclusion, permitting high confidence in assessing the argument without verifying its paleontology.
The complete source and supplemental transcription resolve the material cosmological and projection claims, though they do not verify those claims historically or scientifically.
The pacemaker anecdote answers the narrow privileged-care allegation, but leaves the broader claims about suffering, donations, contraception, and policy untouched.
Specific allegations are offered, but no documentation is supplied and the universal poverty remedy and sweeping net-harm conclusion exceed the evidence shown.
The cited oath, treaty, book, and insignia are concrete participant claims, but neither their accuracy nor their causal significance is established here.
The closing directly reframes salvation’s security and harsh exclusivity as intellectual costs, while leaving the liability-versus-history distinction substantially unanswered.
All pro burdens receive move-level treatment, and the remaining architect, evil, and specificity gaps are already captured, so no separate adjustment is eligible.
The con side covers all critical routes through selected objections, and their cumulative force is already scored rather than a distinct unrepresented consequence.
